key_points: Starbucks announced closure of ~250 North American stores (~1% of footprint) as part of a $1 bn restructuring
Market initially priced in a modest 1.3% stock rise, suggesting some investors view closures as a positive reset
Q2 sales topped estimates and 2026 guidance was raised, providing a short‑term earnings boost
Dividend safety and cash‑flow metrics remain strong, but the closures highlight over‑expansion concerns
Impact is likely to play out over the next few weeks as the restructuring costs and potential same‑store sales effects are realized
